guide-entry-49436a0d61ca939134d2a3b7.description: General Assembly Resolution 76/112 of 9 December 2021 Welcomed the conclusion of the work of the International Law Commission on the protection of the atmosphere and its adoption of the draft preamble and guidelines on the protection of the atmosphere and commentaries thereto; Took note of the views and comments expressed in the debates of the Sixth Committee on the subject, including those made at the seventy-sixth session of the General Assembly, after the International Law Commission had completed its consideration of this topic in accordance with its statute; Also took note of the preamble and guidelines on the protection of the atmosphere, the text of which was annexed to the resolution, with the commentaries thereto, brought them to the attention of States, international organizations and all who may be called upon to deal with the subject, and encouraged their widest possible dissemination; See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/746 )

guide-entry-4cc74b20173adb0a1e3dc365.description: Consideration of comments and observations on the draft preamble and guidelines, as adopted on first reading, received from governments and international organizations, together with proposals for consideration at second reading as well as for the recommendation to the General Assembly. Sixth report of the Special Rapporteur , Mr. Shinya Murase ( 72nd session of the ILC (2021)) A/CN.4/736 ILC Report, A/76/10 , 2021, chap. IV, paras. 29–40

The Commission considered the report at its 3209th to 3214th meetings, on 22, 23, 27, 28 and 30 May and on 3 June 2014 Discussion in Plenary : 3209th , 3210th , 3211th , 3212th , 3213th and 3214th meetings (22, 23, 27, 28 and 30 May and on 3 June 2014) and 3242nd meeting (6 August 2014). ILC Report, A/69/10 , 2014, chap. VIII, paras. 77–122 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/678 )

guide-entry-66f3265aeab254750abcdef3.description: Further consideration of the obligation of States to protect the atmosphere, as initially proposed as draft guideline 4 in the second report, addressing such issues as the duty to prevent transboundary atmospheric pollution, the duty to mitigate the risk of global atmospheric degradation and the duty to assess environmental impacts. Discussion of obligations of sustainable and equitable utilization of the atmosphere, including legal limits on intentional modification of the atmosphere. The report also contains proposals for a preambular paragraph and five new draft guidelines. Third report of the Special Rapporteur , Mr. Shinya Murase ( 68th session of the ILC (2016)) A/CN.4/692 ILC Report, A/71/10 , 2016, chap. VIII, paras. 86–96

Discussion in Plenary : 3197th meeting, held on 9 August 2013. ILC Report, A/68/10 , 2013, chap. XII, para. 168 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/666 )

guide-entry-93dd56d80d678526b840fb58.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its seventy-second session , 26 April–4 June and 5 July–6 August 2021 The Commission had before it the sixth report of the Special Rapporteur ( A/CN.4/736 ), as well as comments and observations received from Governments and international organizations ( A/CN.4/735 ). The Special Rapporteur, in his report, examined the comments and observations received from governments and international organizations on the draft preamble and guidelines, as adopted on first reading. He considered proposals for consideration on second reading, in the light of the comments and observations, and proposed a recommendation to the General Assembly. The Commission considered the sixth report of the Special Rapporteur at its 3508th to 3510th and 3512th to 3515th meetings, from 26 to 28 April, and on 30 April and 3 and 4 May 2021, respectively The Commission, at its 3515th meeting, held on 4 May 2021, decided to refer draft guidelines 1 to 12, together with the preamble, as contained in the Special Rapporteur’s sixth report, to the Drafting Committee, taking into account the debate in the Commission. At its 3529th meeting, held on 27 May 2021, the Commission considered the report of the Drafting Committee ( A/CN.4/L.951 ), and adopted the draft guidelines, together with a preamble , on the protection of the atmosphere on second reading. At its 3549th to 3554th meetings, held from 26 to 29 July 2021, the Commission adopted the commentaries to the draft guidelines and the preamble. At its 3554th meeting, held on 29 July 2021, the Commission decided, in accordance with article 23 of its statute, to recommend that the General Assembly: a ) take note in a resolution of the draft preamble and guidelines on the protection of the atmosphere , annex the draft guidelines to the resolution, and ensure their widest possible dissemination; b ) commend the draft preamble and guidelines, together with the commentaries thereto, to the attention of States, international organizations and all who may be called upon to deal with the subject. Discussion in Plenary: 3508th , 3509th , 3510th , 3512th , 3513th , 3514th , 3515th meetings (26 to 28 and 30 April, and 3 and 4 May 2021), 3529th (27 May 2021), 3549th , 3550th , 3551st , 3552nd , 3553rd , 3554th (26 to 29 July 2021) meetings. ILC Report, A/76/10 , 2021, chap. IV, paras. 29–40 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/746 ) See : Protection of the Atmosphere and Codification and Progressive Development of International Law , lecture by Prof. Shinya Murase (Audiovisual Library of International Law)

guide-entry-9df1897839e18ce1fb9d5f6b.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its sixty-ninth session , 1 May–2 June and 3 July–4 August 2017 The Commission had before it the fourth report of the Special Rapporteur ( A/CN.4/705 and Corr.1 ). The Commission considered the fourth report of the Special Rapporteur at its 3355th to 3359th meetings, on 10, 11, 12, 16 and 17 May 2017, respectively. The debate in Plenary was preceded by a dialogue with scientists organized by the Special Rapporteur on 4 May 2017. Following its debate on the report, the Commission, at its 3359th meeting, on 17 May 2017, decided to refer draft guidelines 9 to 11, as contained in the Special Rapporteur’s fourth report, to the Drafting Committee, taking into account the debate in the Commission. At its 3367th meeting, on 2 June 2017, the Commission considered the report of the Drafting Committee and provisionally adopted three preambular paragraphs and draft guideline 9. At its 3386th and 3387th meetings, on 2 and 3 August 2017, the Commission adopted the commentaries to the draft preambular paragraphs and draft guideline 9 provisionally adopted at the session. Discussion in Plenary : 3355th , 3356th , 3357th , 3358th , 3359th (10 to 17 May 2017), 3367th (2 June 2017), 3386th and 3387th (2 and 3 August 2017) meetings. ILC Report, A/72/10 , 2017, chap. VI, paras. 57–67 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/713 )

guide-entry-a57dc4364614ac437e1d6b9b.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its seventieth session , 30 April–1 June and 2 July–10 August 2018 The Commission had before it the fifth report of the Special Rapporteur ( A/CN.4/711 ). The Special Rapporteur proposed three additional draft guidelines concerning implementation (draft guideline 10), compliance (draft guideline 11) and dispute settlement (draft guideline 12). The Commission considered the fifth report of the Special Rapporteur at its 3405th and 3409th to 3413th meetings, on 17, 22 to, 25 and 29 May 2018, respectively. Following its debate on the report, the Commission, at its 3413th meeting, on 29 May 2018, decided to refer draft guidelines 10 to 12, as contained in the Special Rapporteur’s fifth report, to the Drafting Committee, taking into account the debate in the Commission. At its 3417th meeting, on 2 July 2018, the Commission received and considered the report of the Drafting Committee ( A/CN.4/L.909 ), and provisionally adopted the draft guidelines on the protection of the atmosphere on first reading. At its 3448th to 3450th meetings, on 8 and 9 August 2018, the Commission adopted the commentaries to the draft guidelines. At its 3450th meeting, on 9 August 2018, the Commission decided, in accordance with articles 16 to 21 of its statute, to transmit the draft guidelines on the protection of the atmosphere, through the Secretary-General, to Governments and international organizations for comments and observations, with the request that such comments and observations be submitted to the Secretary-General by 15 December 2019. Discussion in Plenary: 3405th , 3409th , 3410th , 3411th , 3412th , 3413th (17, 22 to 25 and 29 May 2018), 3417th (2 July 2018), 3448th , 3449th , and 3450th (8 and 9 August 2018) meetings. ILC Report, A/73/10 , 2018, chap. VI, paras. 67–78 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/724 )

guide-entry-af04dcbb0de1a626290fed96.description: New set of draft guidelines, incorporating changes made to the original proposals presented in the first report, concerning: definitions, scope, basic principles concerning the protection of the atmosphere, degradation of atmospheric conditions as a common concern of humankind, general obligation of States to protect the atmosphere, and international cooperation. Second report of the Special Rapporteur , Mr. Shinya Murase ( 67th session of the ILC (2015)) A/CN.4/681 + Corr.1 ILC Report, A/70/10 , 2015, chap. V, paras. 45–54

Proposals for draft guidelines 9 to 12. Fourth report of the Special Rapporteur , Mr. Shinya Murase ( 69th session of the ILC (2017)) A/CN.4/705 + Corr.1 ILC Report, A/72/10 , 2017, chap. guide-entry-e88867888e2d494f52f3fc32.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its sixty-eighth session , 2 May–10 June and 4 July–12 August 2016 The Commission had before it the third report of the Special Rapporteur ( A/CN.4/692 ). The Commission considered the third report of the Special Rapporteur at its 3306th, 3307th, 3308th, and 3311th meetings, on 27 and 31 May, and 1 and 7 June 2016. The debate in the Commission was preceded by a dialogue with scientists organized by the Special Rapporteur on 4 May 2016. Following its debate on the report, the Commission, at its 3311th meeting, on 7 June 2016, decided to refer draft guidelines 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7, together with the fourth preambular paragraph, as contained in the Special Rapporteur’s third report, to the Drafting Committee. At its 3314th meeting, on 4 July 2016, the Commission received the report of the Drafting Committee. At its 3315th meeting, on 5 July 2016, the Commission considered and provisionally adopted five draft guidelines and a preambular paragraph. At its 3341st to 3343rd meetings, on 9 and 10 August 2016, the Commission adopted the commentaries to the draft guidelines provisionally adopted at the session. Discussion in Plenary : 3306th , 3307th , 3308th , 3311th (27 and 31 May, and 1 and 7 June), 3314th , 3315th (4 and 5 July), and 3341st , 3342nd and 3343rd (9 and 10 August 2016) meetings. ILC Report, A/71/10 , 2016, chap. VIII, paras. 86–96 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/703 )

guide-entry-e91078577f597d1c09d8f18f.description: Description of the rationale for the topic and the basic approach taken. Discussion of the historical evolution of the protection of the atmosphere in international law. Reference made to the sources relevant to the progressive development and codification of the law on the topic, together with information on the physical characteristics of the atmosphere, to serve as a basis for defining the atmosphere in legal terms. A broad outline of the various elements comprising the general scope of the projects is provided, with a view to identifying the main legal questions to be covered. Discussion of the legal status of the atmosphere. First report of the Special Rapporteur , Mr. Shinya Murase ( 66th session of the ILC (2014)) A/CN.4/667 ILC Report, A/69/10 , 2014, chap. VIII, paras. 77–122

guide-entry-eca0a4ff46d96c72c6bd57ee.description: 69th session of the International Law Commission (2017) Text of draft guideline 9 and preambular paragraphs as provisionally adopted by the Drafting Committee during the sixty-ninth session Statement of the Chair of the Drafting Committee A/CN.4/L.894

guide-entry-faa468684be852f57ce41e58.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its sixty-seventh session , 4 May–5 June and 7 July–7 August 2015 The Commission had before it the second report of the Special Rapporteur ( A/CN.4/681 and Corr.1 (Chinese only)). The Commission considered the report at its 3244th to 3249th meetings, on 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 12 May 2015. In addition to the debate of the Commission, there was a dialogue with scientists organized by the Special Rapporteur on 7 May 2015. The Commission, at its 3249th meeting, on 12 May 2015, decided to refer draft guidelines 1, 2, 3 and 5 to the Drafting Committee, with the understanding that draft guideline 3 be considered in the context of a possible preamble. Moreover, the Special Rapporteur proposed to defer the referral by the Commission of draft guideline 4 on the general obligation of States to protect the atmosphere to the Drafting Committee, pending further analysis in 2016. At its 3260th meeting, on 2 June 2015, the Commission received the report of the Drafting Committee and provisionally adopted draft guidelines 1, 2 and 5 and four preambular paragraphs. At its 3287th to 3288th meetings, on 5 and 6 August 2015, the Commission adopted the commentaries to the draft guidelines provisionally adopted at the session. Discussion in Plenary : 3244th , 3245th , 3246th , 3247th and 3249th meetings (4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 12 May 2015), 3260th meeting (2 June 2015), and 3287th and 3288th meetings (5 and 6 August 2015). ILC Report, A/70/10 , 2015, chap. V, paras. 45–54 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/689 )
